configuration.startupMode.description: Choose the first surface shown by Fikeya Desktop. Project UI is the default Codex-style coding-agent workspace.
configuration.chat.openAtStartup.descrip: Open Fikeya Chat once when this extension is first activated in VS Code or another compatible editor.
configuration.chat.persistWorkspaceHisto: Persist a bounded, credential-redacted copy of Fikeya Chat messages in this workspace. Disabled by default; when disabled, Chat remains process-local.
configuration.agent.autoSaveWorkspaceEdi: Save dirty file-backed documents inside the current Fikeya workspace before an agent run so tools operate on the latest editor contents. Files outside the workspace and untitled documents are never saved by this setting.
